gameDescriptionHtml:
Have you ever been to the Arctic? Do you want to open a motel in the Arctic? With the company of aurora, blizzards, polar days and nights, primeval forests, and wild animals, can you turn a run-down motel into a landmark in the Arctic?

The Arctic has always been a mysterious place. Running a motel in the Arctic is also a rare experience. Through the Arctic Motel Simulator, we not only want to simulate the climate and changeable weather of the Arctic, but also want to bring an Arctic-style motel management experience.

Game Features

  • Expand Your Territory – The Arctic is a vast and sparsely populated place. In the game, you will be able to expand the territory of the motel in the primeval forest.
  • Expand Your Business – It is not easy to find a motel in the Arctic. Motels there often provide many different types of services. In addition to providing various types of rooms for rent, shops selling Arctic specialties and restaurants offering Arctic cuisine can also earn you a lot of money. There are more, including laundries and other businesses waiting for you to discover.
  • Room Types – We have prepared eight room types for players to discover. Different room types have their own advantages, and players can choose freely according to their preferences.
  • Four Seasons Gameplay – Everyone knows that the winter in the Arctic is very cold, but the Arctic still has its own unique four seasons. We simulate the weather and temperature of the four seasons in the Arctic, as well as their corresponding gameplay, such as: controlling room humidity in summer and managing room temperature in winter, RVs that can be rented in spring, summer and autumn, and Arctic igloos in winter.
  • Guns and Hunting – There are many wild animals in the Arctic, so legal hunting is allowed in many places. In the game, players can hunt legally in the winter hunting season. There are also several types of guns available in the game, and players can choose their favorite guns for hunting. Winter Arctic specialty recipes are also one of the purposes of hunting.
  • Employees – Expanding a business can never rely on just one person. In the game, players can hire employees and special agents to expand the business of the motel. Players can train employees and arrange their work according to different focuses.
  • Events and Wanted Criminals – The game is full of various random events, such as traveler partners investigating cheating, police patrolling your motel, health inspections, stranger events, etc. And due to insufficient police presence in the Arctic, the police also need your help in arresting wanted criminals.
